description: Create a credit bundle to sell: a name, price, billing frequency and credits (null for unlimited). status active puts it on sale now; inactive (the default) saves it to activate later. Without a code, one is made from the name. Early access. Needs a Last Price credential with billing write scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

code.description: Unique in the workspace; cannot change later.

credits.description: Credits per period; null for unlimited.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code in upper case; cannot change later.

rollover_credits.description: Most credits that roll over; 0 for none, null for unlimited.

name: create_credit_bundle_plan
